items.item:
1. After Kernel ends a session, reading its access is refused.
   Shows A11-1. [witness: verification:registry_a11_ended_session_access_read_refused]
statements: end(x) accepted => not registered(x) and no record of x remains   -- A11-1

verdicts.item:
1. After Kernel ends a session, reading its access is refused.
   Shows A11-1. [witness: verification:registry_a11_ended_session_access_read_refused]
statements: end(x) accepted => not registered(x) and no record of x remains   -- A11-1
verdicts.why: The check confirms the end is accepted, verifies that no session-table record remains, and detects that the ended identity is unregistered by requiring access reads to be refused identically to a never-registered identity and excluding it from the session list.
